WITH RECURSIVE foo(x) AS
   (SELECT x FROM (VALUES('a' COLLATE "en_US"),('b')) t(x)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT (x || 'c') COLLATE "de_DE" FROM foo WHERE length(x) < 10)
SELECT * FROM foo
